stem.text: This question is about two elements in Group 2, Q and R.
Three of the statements shown are correct for metal Q.
The one remaining statement is correct for metal R.

A.text: A saturated solution of the hydroxide of this metal has the higher pH value.

B.text: This metal has a carbonate that is used in agriculture to reduce the acidity of soil.

C.text: This metal has the greater atomic radius.

D.text: This metal reacts more quickly with cold water.
